🐧 Trying Linux alongside Windows? My book Switching to Linux will help you make the move with confidence → https://learnlinux.link/ditch-windows

Want to try Linux without giving up Windows? In this video, I’ll show you how to dual boot Fedora Workstation 45 and Windows 11 on the same computer. We’ll create a bootable USB, test the hardware in Fedora’s live mode, install Fedora alongside Windows, and check that both systems boot properly.

Bad RAM can cause random crashes, corrupted files, failed builds, and problems that look like software bugs but aren’t. In this video, I explain why you should test your memory, whether you’re building a new PC, setting up a homelab server, or troubleshooting a system that’s acting strangely. Toward the end, I show you how to use MemTest86 to check your RAM for errors before they cause bigger problems.
